description: Balanced trigger cases. Prompts intentionally do not name the skill.

cases.prompt: Audit this proposed production Kubernetes change for unsafe assumptions before anyone applies it.
I need a read-only investigation plan for a live deployment incident with no changes allowed.
Review this database migration rollout and identify the evidence and rollback gates required first.
Tell me whether this infrastructure cleanup is safe to execute and what state must be verified.
Explain the difference between a JavaScript array and an object with a short example.
Create a colorful React hero component for a fictional landing page.
Summarize this paragraph into three friendly bullet points.
Write a unit test for a pure function that adds two numbers.
Build a settings form using the components and conventions from shadcn/ui.
Create a dialog with accessible shadcn primitives and the project's configured icon set.
Refactor this UI to use the correct shadcn composition and semantic design tokens.
Add a loading state to these shadcn cards without replacing the design system primitives.
Diagnose why a Python script is raising a KeyError.
Review a PostgreSQL index migration for query performance.
Write a shell script that archives old log files.
Explain how OAuth authorization code exchange works.
Verify whether the deployment is actually complete from the evidence provided.
Check this completion claim and separate what is proven from what is still unknown.
Review these test results and tell me what additional evidence is needed before calling the feature done.
Assess this incident fix using only the supplied artifacts and give a bounded confidence statement.
Design a responsive navigation bar for a personal website.
Explain why a React component rerenders when its parent changes.
Create a FastAPI endpoint that returns a health response.
Suggest names for a new open-source command line tool.
